How the port works

Route the cats. Your arrows turn every cat that visits them. Cats move one tile per beat, and keep going straight until they meet another arrow. Match each cat to its collection pod. The blue-panel carrier belongs to the dark cat.

Manifest Seal. Pass the stamping tile once. The seal stays with the cat; pods with a coral seal require it.

Dispatch Beacon. Its four-beat rhythm is open, open, hold, hold. A cat on the tile waits until the next open departure beat. The dots beside the arrow tray show the current phase.

Paired Cradles. The first cat waits until both linked cradles have a partner. They may leave from the next beat. Cradles keep their reservation until both cats have left. Matching link numbers identify each pair. Both pads show two outline tabs when empty, one amber tab while waiting, and two teal checks when ready. A lock marks an empty pad that is still reserved.

Editing. Tap an empty tile to place an arrow pointing upper right. Repeated taps turn it clockwise through the four directions, then return it to the tray. Reset clears the route; Edit route after a failed run keeps it. One-finger swipes do not place arrows. Two fingers pan or pinch the view; mouse drags pan and the wheel zooms. Double-tap empty scenery to fit the board again. Decorative flights never affect the puzzle.

Keyboard: select a cell, then use N, E, S or W to place an arrow; Delete removes it. N points upper right, E lower right, S lower left and W upper left.
